connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.3: the site's WAF answers 500 to non-browser user agents and its /ajax throttle is tight, while the app resolves both audio variants per title. All requests now send an iPhone Safari User-Agent and run with maxConcurrentRequests=1 (serial, no bursts) so the resolver (graph#2) stops returning 429. 0.3.2: X-Requested-With removed. 0.3.1: episode fields need selectors. 0.3.0: animeunity.at migration.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
